cards.title: Borrowed Authority
cards.instruction: Project confident authority while quietly working to keep everyone cooperative. Your confidence depends on their cooperation.

cards.title: Secure the Endorsement
cards.instruction: Get a visible endorsement that makes your decision or position harder to challenge.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'd like to keep this voluntary. Would you endorse the new rota into this microphone? Please.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I already said it was fine.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'm still in charge; we can make an adjustment. Quietly. Quietly can't protect me at the staff meeting.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Copy everyone who might blame me.
